title: Composition over inheritance
answer: Composition over inheritance means preferring has-a relationships and delegating to contained objects when reuse does not require a true is-a subtype relationship. Inheritance is appropriate for substitutable domain types, while composition avoids rigid coupling for owned collaborators or data. AeroTopo uses inheritance for `Orthomosaic is a Product`, but `Product has a List<String> tiles` through composition. This keeps tile ownership separate from the product type hierarchy.
